subject: Re: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist — integration follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@finpay.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist — integration follow-up and next steps

Hi Jenna / Mike —

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about FinPay's planned integration patterns. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we discussed:
- You want Redwood hosted inference but traffic will originate from FinPay VPCs (private egress) and should hit a Redwood VPC endpoint (private link / interface endpoint).
- Primary concerns: IP allowlist for control-plane/API, egress/DNS resolution for model downloads (initial onboarding), and mTLS between FinPay services and Redwood private endpoints.
- Integration patterns: SDK + service-to-service API (short-lived keys + mTLS) for production; embeddings + reranker flow for document search.

Action items / asks from FinPay (if you can provide):
1) CIDR ranges or specific egress IPs your infra will use (for IP allowlist).
2) Whether you prefer mutual TLS with client certs or TLS + JWT-based auth (we support both; mTLS preferred for highest assurance).
3) Any egress/DNS restrictions that would block model artifact pulls (we can provide artifact URLs).
4) A contact for your security/networking team (cc'd NetOps would be ideal).

What we (Redwood) will provide: 
- A draft MPA and SOW (attached) outlining private connectivity options and SLAs.
- High-level network diagram showing VPC endpoint placement and routing (attached: finpay-network-diagram.png).
- SDK quickstart and recommended auth patterns for embeddings -> reranker flows. Jonas will follow up with low-level network requirements and test endpoints.

Next meeting suggestion: 30-45 minute technical sync with your NetOps + our infra (Jonas) early next week to confirm IP ranges and certificate exchange. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Files attached: redwood-finpay-mpa-draft.pdf, finpay-network-diagram.png

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@finpay.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Turner <mike.turner@finpay.com>, FinPay Networking <netops@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist — integration follow-up and next steps

Thanks Lauren — this recap is perfect. A few answers from our side: 

- CIDR / egress: Our egress is NAT'd through 18.12.34.0/28 currently; we'll confirm exact NAT IPs with NetOps but the range above is the primary one.
- Auth: Security prefers mTLS for the data plane. We can provision client certs from our internal PKI.
- DNS / egress: We do block some external domains; please list the model artifact domains and registry endpoints you use for initial pulls.

I've looped in NetOps (netops@finpay.com) and Mike (prod infra) to coordinate cert exchange and firewall rules. We're available Tue/Wed next week for a technical sync - propose Tue 11/24 at 10:00 AM PT if that works.

Jenna Ortiz
Head of Platform Integrations | FinPay
jenna@finpay.com | (617) 555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@finpay.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@finpay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist — integration follow-up and next steps

Hi Jenna / Mike —

Thanks for the quick replies and for looping in NetOps. A few technical notes ahead of the sync: 

1) IP allowlist 
- We can open our control-plane to a set of customer egress IPs for API calls. The single-IP NAT (18.12.34.5) will work; please confirm the exact IP(s) you want whitelisted.

2) VPC endpoints / routing 
- For private routing we offer an interface VPC endpoint in your region (private IP) that maps to Redwood’s private front-door. You will need to add route rules in your VPC/subnets to route outbound calls to that endpoint.

3) mTLS cert exchange 
- mTLS is supported. We can either: (a) accept client certs issued by your PKI (you provide certificate chain + subject OIDs), or (b) set up a mutual CA relationship via ACME/managed PKI if you prefer. For initial testing, providing a client cert + key for a short-lived test identity is fine.

4) DNS / model artifacts 
- Model artifacts and container pulls may touch the following domains during onboarding: artifacts.redwood-inference.com, models.redwood-inference.com, and registries.gcr.io for certain base images. If you have egress allowlists by domain, please whitelist these. We can also provide a signed bundle if your environment disallows outbound pull.

5) SDK/Auth patterns (short)
- SDK uses short-lived API tokens (rotate via your auth system) for control plane. For higher assurance we recommend configuring mTLS at the transport layer and using RBAC API keys for per-service identities. For embeddings + reranker flows, we recommend issuing a single service identity per worker pool with scoped tokens.

Test endpoints we will provide during the sync: 
- Private test endpoint: https://private-test.redwood-inference.internal (mTLS-enabled)
- Public test endpoint (for fallback): https://api.redwood-inference.com/test

Please attach the cert chain and the exact IP list in reply so I can prepare firewall rules on our side. I'll bring a short checklist to the sync to run through cert formats, IPs, and a handshake test.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Infra Lead, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna@finpay.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@finpay.com>, FinPay Networking <netops@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC endpoints & IP allowlist — integration follow-up and next steps

Perfect, thank you both. 

Confirming next steps and owners: 
- FinPay (Jenna / NetOps): confirm exact egress IP(s) and attach client cert chain for test identity (owner: netops@finpay.com) - target: today EOD.
- Redwood (Jonas): prepare firewall rules and spin up the private test endpoint (owner: jonas_weber@redwood.com) - target: Tue 11/24 (we'll aim to have test endpoint ready before the sync).
- Redwood (Lauren): update the MPA/SOW and send calendar invite for Tue 11/24 10:00 AM PT (invite to follow).

If anyone prefers a different time, say so now; otherwise I'll send the invite. I'll also open a HubSpot ticket for the integration and attach the MPA draft + network diagram.

Thanks - looking forward to the sync.

Lauren
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
